for m in range(max_mask):

for col in range(1, C + 1):
    for prev_mask in range(max_mask):
        for curr_mask in range(max_mask):
            for next_mask in range(max_mask):
                valid = True
                for b in range(R):

                        neighbor = False
                        if b > 0 and (curr_mask & (1 << (b - 1))) != 0:
                            neighbor = True
                        if b + 1 < R and (curr_mask & (1 << (b + 1))) != 0:
                            neighbor = True
                        if (prev_mask & (1 << b)) != 0:
                            neighbor = True
                        if (next_mask & (1 << b)) != 0:
                            neighbor = True
                        if not neighbor:
                            valid = False
                            break
                if valid:
                    dp[col][curr_mask][next_mask] = min(dp[col][curr_mask][next_mask], dp[col - 1][prev_mask][curr_mask] + bin(prev_mask).count('1'))

max_unspiders = 0
for m in range(max_mask):
    max_unspiders = max(max_unspiders, R * C - (dp[C][m][0] + bin(m).count('1')))

print(max_unspiders)
